ticket.title: The delayed-order reply gives the old support hours
ticket.body:
The saved reply for delayed orders lists support hours of 9:00 to 17:00.
Since 2026-10-01, support answers from 8:00 to 20:00.

instruction.text: Keep the change to the delayed-order reply.

comments.body: The hours are the same on weekends.

answers.question: Which hours apply on public holidays?
From which date does the reply give the new hours?
answers.answer: From today, because the hours changed on 2026-10-01.

proposal:
## What this is

The saved reply for delayed orders lists support hours of 9:00 to 17:00. Since 2026-10-01, support answers from 8:00 to 20:00. The ticket asks that the reply show the new hours.

Assumptions: none

## What is in and out

- In: the support hours in the saved reply for delayed orders.
- Out: other saved replies, and the support hours themselves.

## How Qory would do it

Replace 9:00 to 17:00 with 8:00 to 20:00, and keep the rest of the text.

## Why this is the best

It is the smallest change that makes the reply correct, and the instruction keeps the change to this reply.

## Alternatives

- A link to the help page that lists the hours: a customer would need one more step to find them.

changes.text: Say that the hours apply every day.
